title: Darkholm is on YouTube and Instagram
summary: Watch the Darkholm trailer on YouTube and follow @darkholm.live on Instagram.

title: Darkholm is on X, and has its own email
summary: Follow @darkholmlive for news, clips and contest winners, and reach staff at support@darkholm.live.

title: The Darkholm Pass
summary: A monthly battle pass with daily and weekly quests, 30 tiers of rewards and a season leaderboard. Open it with /pass.

title: No more reinforced deepslate in OneBlock
summary: Reinforced deepslate no longer comes up in the Deep Dark phase.

title: The monthly build contest
summary: Build something, post a screenshot in the Discord, win crate keys.

title: Prizes for the month's top three voters
summary: The three players with the most votes each month now win crate keys.

title: The vote crates come to the Great Hall
summary: All seven reward crates now stand in the Great Hall, where every player arrives.

title: The Great Hall carries your pack
summary: In the Great Hall you now hold the inventory of the realm you just left.

title: A hoe in every kit
summary: Every kit, from Starter to King, now includes a hoe that matches its other tools.

title: New tutorials
summary: A Tutorials page with three guides written from builds on the server.

title: Market vendors open in the bazaar
summary: Nine vendors now trade in the Darkholm bazaar.

title: Every Java version can join
summary: All Java Edition versions can now connect to play.darkholm.live.
